**21 Aug 2025: Define The Leaders**

With corrections we will never know when it ends, but what we can do is to begin defining and tracking potential leaders. Staying focused on a few ideas and closely stalking them for entry points can supercharge your performance when the market does turn. The worst case scenario is you get it wrong and go back to the drawing board, no harm!

A couple of ideas standing out that I am watching closely:

**1) $ETHUSD - **

(A) Weekly chart ran straight up the right side, showing clear accumulation and RS vs. BTC. 

(B) Last night was a multiple edge trading area on the daily chart: (i) Traders defended the uptrend line, (ii) Moving average undercut and rally of the 20-EMA, (iii) Support found on March + December 2024 highs.

(C) If the market continues to chop/correct, the expectation here if ETH is to really go on a huge run is to range between 4-4.8k, building pivots/entry spots before the actual breakout.

**2) Small Caps $IWM $TNA**

Still a little sloppy but evidently showing RS to $QQQ. It is trading above the 20-EMA while the $QQQ is below it. Needs a little more work to prove itself (build constructive pivots to risk against) but good first step.

**3) AI Healthcare $TEM $HNGE $MEDP $XBI $LABU**

(A) $TEM especially, HUGE weekly base - the chop this year has definitely frustrated a lot of traders.

(B) Recent price action has begun to show linearity, the bigger the base = higher in space.

(C) Clear string of 10-day pocket pivot volume signatures = Accumulation (Light blue volume bars). Personally watching for a trade-able pivot on a breakout to new highs.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Definitely a couple more to list but the headspace around this is less = more = focused trading. Jackson hole could definitely ruin things but again, the worst case is simply to go back to the drawing board. Good to have a couple of short ideas from old themes for balance.
